name: Twin-prime centers / 6
description: Positive integers n for which 6n − 1 and 6n + 1 are both prime.

name: Decimal self numbers
description: Positive integers absent from the image m + decimal digit sum(m).

name: Loeschian numbers
description: Nonnegative integers of the form x² + xy + y², including 0.

name: Cyclic numbers
description: Positive integers a with gcd(a, φ(a)) = 1.

name: Beatty: (1 + √3)/2
description: a(n) = floor(n(1 + √3)/2), computed exactly using integer square roots.

name: Beatty: 2 + √3
description: a(n) = floor(n(2 + √3)), computed exactly using integer square roots.

name: Integer divisor averages
description: Positive integers whose sum of divisors is divisible by their number of divisors.

name: Primes ≡ 5 or 7 (mod 8)
description: Primes congruent to 5 or 7 modulo 8.

name: Primes ≡ 2 or 3 (mod 5)
description: Primes congruent to 2 or 3 modulo 5.

name: Binary numbers without 111
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no three consecutive 1s, including 0.

name: Binary numbers without 000
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 000, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Take one, skip one, take two…
description: Take 1 integer, skip 1, take 2, skip 2, and so on, starting with the positive integers.

name: Skip one, take one, skip two…
description: Skip 1 integer, take 1, skip 2, take 2, and so on, starting with the positive integers.

name: Require four squares
description: Positive integers requiring four nonzero squares: precisely the numbers 4^r(8m + 7), with r, m ≥ 0.

name: Prime factors ≡ 1 (mod 3)
description: Positive integers whose prime divisors are all congruent to 1 modulo 3; includes 1.

name: Prime factors ≡ 1 (mod 4)
description: Positive integers whose prime divisors are all congruent to 1 modulo 4; includes 1.

name: Prime factors ≡ 3 (mod 4)
description: Positive integers whose prime divisors are all congruent to 3 modulo 4; includes 1.

name: Binary numbers without 101
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 101, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Binary numbers without 110
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 110, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Binary numbers without 011
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 011, without leading zeroes; includes 0.
